legend: In high-level Punch-Out!! speedrunning, the world record for the fight against the legendary "Mike Tyson" is decided by frame-perfect execution. In specific phases of the run, after landing an initial punch, you have a razor-thin window to land a follow-up strike:

If you land the second punch within the interval [a,b]$$$[a, b]$$$, Tyson is stunned and the fight timer remains low. However, if your timing is even one frame too early or too late, he triggers a lengthy taunt animation, effectively ending your world record attempt.

You have been practicing this two-punch sequence relentlessly, recording the exact frame timing of your second punch for n$$$n$$$ consecutive attempts. To measure your progress, you want to analyze your "consistency streaks." A good run is defined as any contiguous subarray of attempts where your average timing falls perfectly within the taunt skip window.
Calculate the total number of non-empty contiguous subarrays of your practice session that qualify as a good run.
input: The first line of input contains three space-separated integers n$$$n$$$, a$$$a$$$, and b$$$b$$$ (1≤n≤2⋅105,1≤a≤b≤2⋅105$$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5, 1 \le a \le b \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of attempts, and the minimum and maximum value of the interval of good runs.

The second line contains n$$$n$$$ space-separated integers p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \dots, p_n$$$ (1≤pi≤2⋅105$$$1 \le p_i \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$), where pi$$$p_i$$$ represents the frame timing of the second punch on your i$$$i$$$-th attempt.
output: Print a single integer, the total number of contiguous subarrays that are good runs.

legend.ai: 在高水平的《Punch-Out!!》速通中，与传奇人物“迈克·泰森”进行战斗的世界纪录取决于帧级精准操作。在速通的特定阶段中，成功打出第一拳后，你只有一个极其短暂的窗口来打出后续攻击：
如果你在区间 [a,b]$$$[a, b]$$$ 内打出第二拳，泰森会被击晕，战斗计时器仍然很低。然而，如果你的时机甚至早或晚了一帧，他就会触发一段冗长的嘲讽动画，实际上使你的世界纪录尝试直接失败。
你一直在不懈练习这一套两拳连招，并记录了连续 n$$$n$$$ 次尝试中第二拳的精确帧数。为了衡量自己的进步，你想分析“稳定连胜”。一段表现良好的过程被定义为：尝试序列中的任意连续子数组，其平均时机恰好落在跳过嘲讽的窗口内。
计算你的练习过程中符合良好区间条件的非空连续子数组总数。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含三个空格分隔的整数 n$$$n$$$、a$$$a$$$ 和 b$$$b$$$(1≤n≤2⋅105,1≤a≤b≤2⋅105$$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5, 1 \le a \le b \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)——分别表示尝试次数，以及良好区间的最小值和最大值。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个空格分隔的整数 p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \dots, p_n$$$(1≤pi≤2⋅105$$$1 \le p_i \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)，其中 pi$$$p_i$$$ 表示你第 i$$$i$$$ 次尝试中第二次击打的帧时间。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示符合良好区间条件的连续子数组总数。
